title: caucalis gracilis f. umbrosa
intro: Caucalis gracilis f. umbrosa, commonly known as the lesser hemlock or umbrella lesser hemlock, is a plant species that belongs to the family Apiaceae. This plant is valued for its medicinal properties, which include health benefits such as reducing inflammation, improving digestion, and supporting respiratory health. The therapeutic actions of Caucalis gracilis f. umbrosa include expectorant, anti-inflammatory, and carminative properties, making it a potential treatment for coughs, colds, and digestive issues. The bioactive constituents of this plant include alkaloids, glycosides, and saponins, which contribute to its therapeutic effects.
